batting.name: Mandeep Singh

balls.text: Yes, caught just a few centimetres out of his crease. Played it back, the bowler ran towards the ball as the batsmen were going for a run and threw the stumps down. Third umpire called to adjudicate and he gives it out.
short of a length, he jumped back and tried to defend it but it hits the pad and they get a single.
Dinda swings hard at it but it's way away from hitting anywhere near the bat.
played away clumsily on the leg-side for a single.
on the back-foot and defended, went for a quick one and had the square-leg fielder hit, he could have been out.
bouncer and the batsman tries to pull him away, missed it by some distance.
driven through the covers for a single. End of an excellent spell from Mascarenhas, started the rot in the Pune innings and ended with five wickets.
that kept low, but Nehra defends it well to the short mid-wicket region and they also run away for a single.
Gone, caught! That wasn't a quick ball by any stretch and the batsman launched into it, it went high in the air but was lacking in the distance. Mandeep Singh at deep mid-wicket catches it well.
jags back in to the batsman and he does enough to play it away to leg-side.
down the leg-side and Nehra fails to get anything on it, wide called.
Bowled him! Tried to act cute, tried to sweep him over the short fine-leg region but it has gone through and he is castled. Eight down.
pitched right up and Manhas has absolutely launched it over the the long-off fence for a six! That will bring some life in that Pune dressing room!
outside the off-stump and the batsman goes for a swing, but gets only an inside edge through to the deep square-leg. The short fine-leg fielder gives it a chase and they take 2.
pitched up and he swings at it, gets nothing on his bat.
short ball and the number nine batsman goes under that one. Rahul Sharma is really tall and that would have been some effort!
gone, caught! Pitched right up and Pandey went for the drive, it went only as far as the short cover fielder, David Hussey and the side has lost its seventh wicket.
seemed like a bit slower on to the middle stump and that is played over to long-on for a single. 100 comes up, probably 3-4 overs later than when Pune would have wanted it.
short and outside the off-stump but he fails to unleash the cut successfully. Extra bounce was his undoing.
and another one that rips away from the batsman, beating him rather easily outside the off-stump.
Full on the off-stump and defended stoutly on the front-foot.
Bowled this time! Googly I think, and Smith tried to hit it square, gets an inside edge and that rolls back on to the stumps. No cameo from Smith this time and Pune are six down.
outside the off-stump and Smith was beaten because of the turn.
flighted and pitched right up to the batsman, who drills it through the cover region for a couple of runs.
Shorter in length but outside the off-stump and he gets a single to bring Smith back on strike.
another shorter one from the bowler and this time he goes on to his back-foot and slaps it to the mid-wicket region for a four! Welcome boundary.
short and rising and Smith plays it away to the off-side for no run.
Manhas is waiting on his bat-foot for the short of length ball and is dabbing it around for singles. He does that yet again to the off-side.
short of length, on the back-foot and defended it towards mid-on.
cut hard towards the point region and that could have easily gone to the fence, before Mandeep dived to his left and stopped it
short of a good length and Smith defends it on the back-foot. Wanted a single but calls of "No, no no!"
they have peppered the leg-side region well in that over and picked up singles rather easily. Another one there for Smith.
bowls from wide of the crease, coming back into the batsman as well and again, played on the leg-side!
played away to the leg-side for another single. Doing it well here, are the Pune Warriors.
short and outside the off-stump and they get a single.
played away to the leg-side once again for a single.
turning away, played away to the leg-side for a couple.

beaten yet again, this time the ball was jagging back into the batsman and he had no clue about this one. Fortunately for him and the team, a. the ball missed the stumps and b. even the wicket-keeper had not much clue! Four byes!
outside the off-stump again, and beats the outside edge of the bat.
again outside the off-stump, moving away and he plays it to the third-man for a single.
on off-stump, short of length and that jags away from the batsman. Beats the outside edge through to the wicket-keeper.
played away late to the third-man and Smith is now on strike.

Gone! Out! Mascarenhas has stuck yet again! The ball was slower and Uthappa went for a flick shot, in a bid to clear the boundary, but found the only fielder in that region. Half the side is now sent back!
quicker one, slides through fast as well and the batsman had no idea whether to go forward or back to that, caught in the crease and the outside edge is missed too.
goes over the bowler's head and smashes it for a four!
Googly! That came in with the arm and the batsman did not read it too well, wanted to cut it and managed to get the ball down in time.
pitched up and the batsman went back there when he could have come forward. Attempts a cut but misses
driven to the long-on for a single.
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off-stump, driven for a single
On the middle and Manhas wanted to flick it away to the leg-side, but it came on to him quicker than he thought it would and he can get it as far as the fine-leg fielder for a run.
floats it up for the batsman, full-toss and he drives it to wide long-off for a couple. Rameez Raja on commentary calls it a soft ball.
too many down the leg-side, this time does not get the bat and they call it a wide.
short of a good length, goes on to the back-foot and defends to the point region.
drifts down the leg-side and Manhas gets a bat on to it, the glance gets the batsman four, with the fielder squarer at fine-leg!
jumps down the track and tries to cut it away, but straight to the short cover fielder.
short of length, driven on the up by a batsman who is standing well outside the crease. Single to long-off.
pitched right up to the batsman, driven to the right of the sweeper fielder and by the time he could run and get the ball back, the batsmen had time to run two. Seven runs in the over.
short and cut away by Manhas, but to the fielder.
slow this time and Uthappa waited on it, played it gently on to the off-side for a single.
pitched on the middle and turned away well by Manhas to deep square-leg for a single.
short again, turning away and Uthappa cuts it to the sweeper.
short and pulled away to the wide long-on. They run well for a couple.
pitched right up to the bat and hits the toe of Manhas' bat. End of an expensive, but successful over.
defended it back to the bowler. A six, a four and a wicket in this over so far.
driven straight back to the bowler and that has gone to the fence. They are not ceasing to play their strokes, are the Warriors.
gone! Mathews is out, lbw, trying to work the bowler to the leg-side. It hit hum flush in front of the middle-stump and looked gone the moment they appealed.
dabbed away on the off-side and gets a single. Six followed by a single, on this kind of green pitch, is good batting.
Shot! Pitched up to the bat and Uthappa, immediately after the break plays with a bat as straight as straight can be! That is gone all the way
tapped it on the off-side for a single and the Time-Out has been taken.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single
goes over the mid-off fielder and gets it to the fence! Matthews is taking the bowling on, taking advantage of the attacking field.
pitched on the middle-stump and Uthappa gently taps it to the the deep square-leg region for a single.
outside the off-stump, pitched right up, driven to the covers.
pitched right up and that is driven rather well. More vitally, it is placed excellently to the left of mid-on, who was in the circle.
outside the off-stump and defended yet again by Uthappa. End of PK's spell, he gave away 19 in his four overs.
pitched on middle and swung sharply, but down the leg-side and the umpire calls it a wide.
short this time and pulled away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single.
defended on the back-foot, the runs aren't coming and with three wickets down, they cannot take too many chances.
this time he plays it to the leg-side for a single.
outside the off-stump and Uthappa fails to get a bat on that, trying to cut the ball!
played away to the square-leg fielder and no chance to rotate the strike over.
and this one pitches on the middle and comes into the batsman. Mascarenhas would probably think he is bowling in England under these conditions.
Oooooh! That swung away from the batsman and he had no chance of getting anywhere close to it
bowled! A torturous innings has been ended, bowled off a straight ball that looked to be coming into the batsman but deviated that little bit, to take the stumps! Three down and in trouble.
tucked away to the fine-leg region for a single.
again drifts down the leg-side, this time to the right-hander and its tucked to the leg-side. Some confusion but makes it back to the crease.
gone! First ball! That pitched on the leg-stump and Ganguly tried to play it to the leg-side, leading edge and it loops up to the point fielder for an easy catch.
nips back in sharply and Samuels uneasily fends it off, just one off the over
steers it towards cover point and can;t pinch a run there, Samuels kept quiet here
keeps it nice and tight and Samuels gets across and defends
slides down the leg side and wide called
dropped it to the off side and thought of a single
gets across and pushes it to the off side
even Praveen gets fizz off the wicket, Samuels poked at it again and it kicked up and beat the edge
makes room and scoops a full delivery over extra cover, should have been a four but the outfield slowed it down
nicely played, opened the face of the bat and steered it past the slips and down to third man
extra bounce and fizz off the wicket, foxed Samuels as he poked at it outside the off stump and was beaten
goes back at the crease and drops it down to cover point
Ganguly of the old! Made room again and hit that in the air wide of extra cover and mid-off
tucked away in front of the hips to the leg side
talk about placement! There was a big gap between the slips and gully and Ganguly made a bit of room and placed it between them, deliberately steered it there
gets across and chops it down to cover
kicked up off the pitch and nudged to the on side, the batsman was surprised by the bounce
nips back in off the seam and good bounce and carry to the keeper

communication breakdown! Ryder dropped that towards cover and he was a long way out of the crease, Ganguly saw it was Hussey and in desperation asked his partner to head back, too late, the throw to Gilchrist was accurate, Ryder was in another town
slides it down the leg side and wide called
more the Ryder we know, fetches that from outside off and swings across the line and clears the left of mid-on
short and he pulls that over square leg, the sweeper mops up
lazy running! Dropped towards Hussey at cover and Ganguly was ball-watching, direct hit and he would have gone
full and wide and he chases that and gets an outside edge that sails down to third man
drops it with soft hands towards point but decides against the single
moves away and he chases that, only narrowly beats the toe of the bat
full outside off and thudded down the pitch back to the bowler who plucks it with his right hand
Ganguly decides to use his feet and club a length ball past the bowler and mid-off, in the air but safe
bounce and carry! That really kicked up and fizzed past the outside edge, encouraging from Praveen
drifts on the pads and he works it to deep square leg
lands it on the same area and Ryder's happy to knock it back to the bowler
moves away and Ryder pushes it down to cover
movement and sharp cut away from the left-hander, Ryder did well to leave that alone
slashed through the covers and that should go to the fence, and also be the end of the game! Punjab have got themselves on to the board!
dropped, yet again! Tried to slash Samuels and it got more height than distance, should have been caught at point but he failed to get his hands to that.
spinning away from the bat and dabbed away to the short third-man.
driven away to the mid-wicket for a single.

overthrows and they get five. Defended on the off-side and the fielder swooped down on it and threw it wildly over the stumps at the non-striker's end, the fielders backing it failed to get a hand to it and it goes racing away for overthrows.
short again from Dinda and it is pulled away this time by Chawla, getting him a single.
played away to the off-side but does not get any runs.
another bouncer and Chawla lets that go. Looks expectedly at the umpire for a wide but he is not getting one.
an expected response from Dinda, short ball and Chawla was in two minds, whether or not to pull it. In the end, he pulled out!
comes down the pitch and drives it on the full for a single to long-on.
on the middle and Marsh needed to quickly come down on it, flick it away to the leg-side for a single.
short one and that is pulled away by Chawla but only to deep square-leg for a run.
pulls his length back and the batsman plays it away to square-leg for a run.
Shot, Six! He pitched it up to Marsh, who smacked it over long-on for a six! Into the stands and that is the first six of the innings.
short ball from Rahul Sharma, Chawla tries to play the pull stroke and that goes high in the air, Mathews ran in from deep square-leg but fails to latch on despite diving full-length.
driven away to long-off and the batsmen come back for the second run that takes Marsh to his half-century! Excellent innings under pressure, especially after being out of form.
pitched on middle, and Marsh has flicked it away to the mid-wicket fence for a one-bounce four.The umpire called it a six but later changed it to four.
goes for a hit on the up but can get only up to the long-on, where it goes on a bounce for a single to long-off.
short and pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
Dropped! That should have been caught at long-on by Ashok Dinda and it was Shaun Marsh. Marsh lofted him to long-off and Dinda ran in hard but the ball popped out of the hands!
jags back into Marsh and he defends the ball into the off-side region.
again goes for a drive but it unable to make too much of a contact. Where is David Hussey, I wonder whether he is injured or was it just a tactical move to get in Chawla before Hussey.
wants to go down the track and smack it but it goes back to the bowler.
late cuts him again for a single.
finally gets him away for a single, the required-rate is at six.
goes down the track but the length's shortened and he does not get it off the middle.
short and pulled really hard. Unfortunately straight to the deep square-leg fielder.
tries to drive it but the ball falls short of the short cover fielder in Smith.
slower one and Chawla misses, Uthappa dislodges the bails. Third-umpire has been called for but the foot is slightly inside.
driven through the covers for a four! The fielder tried to use his leg but failed to get down.
drives towards long-on but Smith ran towards it and prevented it from going for a single!
quicker one and Chawla needed to be quick there to get his bat down.
slower and driven to the off-side. Falls short of the fielder.
drives it to the long-off for a single.
played away to the off-side for nothing
short and Mandeep wanted to pull it away, got the leading edge which spoons up for Smith to catch at short cover.
tried to cut that one, but does not get it where he wanted.
edged and dropped? Went for a slashing cut and it was a big edge, something a regular keeper would have found difficult as well. Robin Uthappa is not a regular keeper.
shorter in length and played away to the leg-side for a run.
slows the pace down drastically for this one and Mandeep is able to drive it to long-on for another single.
another fast yorker, and Marsh plays it rather easily to long-off for a run.
a very quick yorker and Mandeep did well to dig it out for a single.
played it gently to the leg-side but don't risk going for a run.
that bounced a tad more than one would have thought but Mandeep late cut it away through the slips for a four!
pitched right up and driven through the covers for a single.
another slower one and this time he drives it through point for a run.
slower one and dabbed away to the point fielder yet again. Three dots in a row after that four.
repeat that again, short again, cut away again and straight to Smith at point.
short and cut away and straight to the fielder.
Whoa! What a stroke, reminds one of his performances in the 2008 IPL, middles that one alright, through extra-cover and despite the presence of long-off, he was getting nowhere close to it!
Tries to smash him through the off-side but not off the middle of the bat.

Missed! slightly slower and the batsman drives it away beautifully away, they go for the second run. Marsh was miles away from the crease when Ryder got the throw and tried to dislodge the stumps, but Ryder hit the stumps with his hands, despite gathering the ball well!
flicked away through point, Smith dived to his left but could not stop it.
short ball and Mandeep has pulled it away to long-on for a single.
pitched on the middle and defended on the back-foot.
very close to cut again, coming into the batsman, but the batsman seems to have it covered.
played away to the off-side where he gets no run.
out, caught! Slashed away by Gilchrist, was travelling rapidly but Smith jumps high on his left and they are two down.
that's outside the off-stump, not really up to the bat and the ball is smacked over the extra-cover region for a single. It was in the air but did not go too far.
slower one and Gilly reads it early and well, and dabs it to third-man for a single.
outside the off-stump and the batsman slashed it away, was going to the fence, but Samuels dived to his left and saved it from going for a certain four.
this time he pitches it up and Marsh drives it through the covers for a single
short of length, outside the off-stump, and Marsh misses the cut shot.
short again and the batsman gets an inside-edge to the short fine-leg. They are playing it just fine here.
tries to cut it away but does not get it off the middle of the bat.
defended on the back-foot.
Short! Driven through the extra-cover and for four, neither mid-off nor covers had a chance there.
shortens the length and the batsman rocks back and taps it away.
outside the off-stump, slightly fuller and Marsh throws his bat at it, gets it to the deep fielder, where he has to dive to save it from going to the fence.
good length on middle, turns it wide of mid-on for a couple of runs
on the middle stump, and in the slot, Gilly has smacked it over the bowler for a four.
shot! Drives through the mid-on region and it beats the fielder. This did not look too well-timed but was enough to beat Ganguly.
Outside the off-stump and Gilchrist wanted to spank it really hard, gets a bottom edge but lucky it was not on to his stumps.
short and cut away through the point region for the second four of the over.
slower in the air yet again, he fails to get any bat on it and the wicket-keeper gets it.
shorter and slower, Marsh wants to play it hard but beats him.
goes straight through and beats the bat.
drilled through the extra-cover field and Marsh gets a four! Good shot from the Aussie batsman.
driven on the leg-side but without any timing.
driven on the up and straight to the fielder. Six runs off the Nehra over.
down the leg-side, poorly directed delivery and Gilchrist got a bit of bat there. Spoils the over which was shaping up to be a good one...
slower one from Nehra, Gilly was shaping for a cut but checked his stroke at the last moment.
again on the middle stump and the batsman plays it away to the third-man region for a single.
moving away from the batsman and beating him all ends! Marsh had problems outside the off-stump in that series against India late last year and on this pitch his technique will be tested.
coming into the batsman and played away gently on to the off side. Runs away for a quick single.
swinging right back into Marsh and the batsman defends on his back-foot. Only one run off that over!
too close to play the cut, but Marsh tries to glide it away, and can go only up to the point fielder.
short yet again and defended on the back-foot by Marsh.
goes for a pull and there is a huge appeal for a caught appeal. Umpire gives it not-out, but there did seem like some kind of a sound there.
short of a length and it keeps a bit low. Bit of uneven bounce, sometimes it is not rising up to the heights that the batsman expects.
unleashes the pull shot but did not get the middle of the bat and the ball rolls over to the fine-leg fielder for a single.
short again from Nehra and Gilchrist who almost looked like he wanted to pull the ball, finally decided on just tapping it to the leg-side and hurrying off for a single.
on the middle-stump, short of length and moving away from the batsman. Defended on the back-foot.
defended on the back-foot to a ball that was short of good length and the batsmen are away for a single. Nehra looks anything but amused with the fielding.
driven to the right of Sourav Ganguly fielding at mid-off and the captain has mis-fielded. He should have been diving there, but he did attempted to field it without doing so.
short of length and Marsh goes on to the front-foot to defend it back.
outside the off-stump and moving further away from the bat. Marsh wanted to go after it, but beats his outside edge.
another inside edge and Marsh is lucky it is does not go back to his stumps. Instead, it goes to the leg-side and they jog across for a single.
short ball this time and he has pulled it to the deep square-leg fence for four! First boundary for the home side.
outside the off-stump and Marsh almost gets an inside edge to the stumps.
Pitches on leg, moving further away and played away to the fine-leg for a single.
outside the off-stump, moving further away and Marsh tries to fiddle at it, gets an edge and it goes through the slips. Yep, there are three slips in place!
Bowled him! First ball! Pitched a tad short of good length and for some reason, Valthaty went on to his back-foot and the ball skids through his defences.
